title: uva-ursi patula
intro: Uva-ursi patula, commonly known as Bearberry, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to the cooler regions of the Northern Hemisphere. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to support urinary tract health and reduce inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions of being antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory. Uva-ursi patula contains bioactive constituents such as arbutin, hydroquinone, and ursolic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The plant's bioactive compounds have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic activities, making it a valuable natural remedy for various health conditions.
